target.title: refactor: consolidate generic number clamps
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The first number-coercion consolidation pass in #99671 migrated finite-number and integer option callers, but generic inclusive clamp mechanics still had a legacy implementation in `src/utils.ts` plus exact local copies in agents and the Control UI.

## Why This Change Was Made

This makes `@openclaw/normalization-core/number-coercion` the canonical owner for policy-free numeric clamping, preserves the existing `clamp`, `clampInt`, and `clampNumber` facade exports, and removes exact local copies. Finite-number validation in the touched Control UI path now uses the existing canonical helper. Units, defaults, fallback/error policy, domain bounds, retry policy, and semantic sentinels remain local.

## User Impact

No intended user-visible behavior change. The same inclusive bounds and integer-flooring contracts now have one implementation, with 11 fewer net production lines.

## Evidence

- Focused tests: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/normalization-core/src/number-coercion.test.ts src/utils.test.ts src/logging/log-tail.test.ts src/agents/memory-search.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/bash-command.stop.test.ts src/agents/code-mode.test.ts src/agents/agent-tools.create-openclaw-coding-tools.adds-claude-style-aliases-schemas-without-dropping-g.test.ts ui/src/ui/chat/grouped-render.test.ts`
  - Result: 7 Vitest shards passed; 212 tests passed.
- Testbox-through-Crabbox: `tbx_01kwnhm5zk4naq0b08emjkxt06`, Actions run `28693088275`, exit 0.
  - `pnpm check:changed` passed core production/test typechecks, lint with zero warnings/errors, guards, duplicate coverage, and import-cycle checks.
  - Full `pnpm build` passed, including plugin SDK export validation and Control UI build.
- Fresh local autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings; correctness confidence 0.98.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Production LOC: 30 additions, 41 deletions; net -11.
